items: COMFORTABLE OUTDOOR COUCH：Patio sectional sofa with soft and thick cushions, generous sizes, and robustness and lightness to meet the people’s outdoor needs. Combines traditional and modern design using lightweight material-rattan. Water-resistant enough to withstand all-weather changes for a long service life.

EASY CLEANING AND MAINTAIN：The cushion covers of this outdoor sectional furniture set are lightly removable with a zipper design for easy cleaning of dirty stains. The waterproof cover allows you to not have to worry about rain and spills. In addition, the glass table has a heat-resistant glass top that can be cleaned by simply wetting a towel, or even using boiling water for tougher stains.

items.label: TRANSFORMABLE SOFA SET
items.value: This l shaped patio couch is composed of 3 parts, including loveseat, lounge sofa & coffee table, where loveseat and lounge sofa can be combined to form the l shaped outdoor sofa or converted into any shape, making the product suitable for both sitting and sleeping.The table legs are adjustable to ensure a comfortable seating position no matter what your size. It is suitable for outdoor patio, porch, garden, balcony or poolside.

items.label: FULLY WATERPROOF MATERIAL
items.value: The material of this outdoor conversation set can withstand any weather, whether it's windy, sunny, rainy, or cold, and won't lead to cracking, sagging, or fading.Furthermore, the rattan has been roughed up to make it more realistic and close to the natural environment. Sturdy while meeting your outdoor needs and comfort.

items.label: FOR RELAXATION TIME
items.value: This l shaped patio furniture is made of sturdy and lightweight Rattan, designed to fit into any outdoor location with its nature-inspired style.Cushion is waterproof while ensuring comfort and softness. All-weather adaptable material adds durability and sturdiness to the product. This patio furniture is designed to meet the needs of the outdoors.
